props.markdown:
The gear of 10 teeth drives the gear of 30, which turns 3 times slower. On the same axle, the gear of 8 drives the gear of 32, which turns 4 times slower. Together, 3 × 4 = 12.

Each pair reverses the direction: after both pairs, the hour hand turns clockwise, like the minute hand.
Turn the minute hand, and watch the gears behind the dial.

props.title: The whole clock, its dial seen through
props.textAlternative: **Text version.** The clock again, seen slightly from the side, with a clear dial. Behind it, the coral gear of 10 teeth on the minute shaft drives the yellow gear of 30; the yellow gear of 8 on the same axle drives the green gear of 32, which carries the hour hand on its tube around the minute shaft. A full turn of the minute hand moves the hour hand by 1 hour. A switch makes the dial opaque or clear.
